messages.content:
Write a two-sentence reply acknowledging this billing issue and saying a human will follow up within one business day. Do not promise a refund.

From: dana.k@example.com
My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was charged twice for order ORD-1042. Please refund one charge.

response.text: We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the duplicate charge on your card ending in 4111. A human will follow up within one business day to resolve this issue.
